unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to abstract geriatric assessment domains from EHR notes as a substitute for in-person geriatric assessment
Calculating a hallucination score to evaluate LLM-extracted text against source notes

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility and accuracy (including hallucination scoring) of using an LLM to abstract and summarize geriatric assessment domains from retrospective EHR notes without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
